heading.title: Special Provisions Relating to Certain Persons Other Than a Company

article.title: Application of other provisions of this Act.
article.content: Save as otherwise provided in this Chapter, all other provisions of this Act shall apply to a person referred to in this Chapter.

115JEApplication of other provisions of this Act.

Section 115JE · Chapter XII-BA · page 479 of the Act
